title: DocuClean & LedgerClean MCP Actor Input
description: Run directly as a Pay-Per-Event batch Actor or connect via Standby Streamable HTTP MCP at /mcp.

tool.title: Tool to Execute (Batch Mode)
tool.description: Select which tool to invoke when running as an Apify batch job. In Standby mode, MCP clients call tools directly via /mcp.
enumTitles: Extract & Clean PDF / HTML / Messy Tables to XLSX ($0.02)
Repair CJK CSV Mojibake & Formula Injection ($0.005)

statements.title: Statement Files (reconcile_statements_and_invoices)
statements.description: Array of payment statement objects ({ filename, content? | contentBase64? }) from Alipay, WeChat Pay, Stripe, PayPal, or bank CSV exports.

invoices.title: Electronic Invoice Files (reconcile_statements_and_invoices)
invoices.description: Array of invoice objects ({ filename, content? | contentBase64? }) in CN Digital e-Invoice XML/PDF, UBL 2.1 XML, CSV, or JSON format.

baseCurrency.title: Base Accounting Currency
baseCurrency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for executive P&L rollups (e.g. CNY, USD, EUR).

expectedBuyerName.title: Expected Buyer Legal Name (Optional Tax Compliance Check)
expectedBuyerName.description: Company or entity name expected in the Buyer field of incoming expense invoices.

expectedBuyerTaxId.title: Expected Buyer Tax ID / USCC (Optional Tax Compliance Check)
expectedBuyerTaxId.description: 18-character Unified Social Credit Code or VAT/EIN expected on incoming expense invoices.

filename.title: Input Filename (PDF Table Extraction or CJK Mojibake Repair)
filename.description: Filename hint with extension (e.g. statement.pdf, report.html, export.csv).

contentBase64.title: Base64 Binary Payload (PDF / GBK / Big5 / UTF-16 Bytes)
contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw file bytes for PDF extraction or raw legacy-encoded CSV repair.

content.title: Raw Text / HTML / Markdown / CSV / JSON Payload
content.description: Direct string payload when sending text, HTML tables, Markdown tables, JSON, or double-encoded mojibake text.

mergePages.title: Stitch Multi-Page Continuation Tables
mergePages.description: Automatically stitch continuation tables across PDF pages that repeat identical headers.

dedupeRows.title: Deduplicate Identical Data Rows
dedupeRows.description: Remove exact duplicate rows while preserving original row order.

injectFormulas.title: Generate Live Excel SUM / AVERAGE Summary Rows
injectFormulas.description: Append live =SUM() and =AVERAGE() summary rows for numeric columns in generated .xlsx files.

address.title: Wallet / Contract Address (validate_multichain_address)
address.description: Address string to validate across EVM, Tron, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, XRPL, Cosmos, or Stacks.

chain.title: Expected Blockchain Hint (Optional)
chain.description: Optional chain constraint: auto, evm, tron, bitcoin, solana, ton, xrpl, cosmos, or stacks.

data.title: Raw EVM Hex Calldata (decode_and_audit_evm_calldata)
data.description: 0x-prefixed hex calldata string for EVM transaction pre-flight decoding.

typedData.title: EIP-712 TypedData v4 Payload (audit_eip712_signature_payload)
typedData.description: Full eth_signTypedData_v4 JSON object containing domain, types, primaryType, and message.
